modularrouters_extruder_side_fast_path.conversion: @Inject HEAD (cancellable) of ModularRouterBlockEntity.calculateIncomingRedstonePower: while the router's extension data is empty RouterExtruderSides.power answers it with the same six getExtensionData / nonNullLevel / getSignal calls in the same order, without building and looking up the ExtruderDist keys; with extension data the router's own code runs. Exact; shipped off by default under the speed rule: a router with extension data pays the hook (true stock 191 -> 199 ns, eight fresh JVMs) while every other router answers about twice as fast (136 -> 65 ns). Runtime flag modularroutersExtruderSideFastPath. Helper bons.furious.patch.modularrouters_coo49.RouterExtruderSides.
modularrouters_extruder_side_fast_path.license: Modular Routers (MIT): the method's logic is restated in our helper (MIT permits it); no code copied verbatim

modularrouters_vacuum_negative_split_fix.conversion: @ModifyArg on the ItemStack.split argument in CompiledVacuumModule.handleItemMode: a negative amount becomes 0 (nothing taken, nothing inserted, no particles), every other amount unchanged. Gameplay fix (off by default): a vacuum module whose buffer already holds more than its regulator amount no longer duplicates the item on the ground; off by default under the speed rule (the hook costs about 2 ns on every vacuumed item: true stock 72.97 -> 75.06 ns per module run, eight fresh JVMs). Runtime flag modularroutersVacuumNegativeSplitFix. Helper bons.furious.patch.modularrouters_coo49.RouterVacuumClamp.
